key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: カギが　かかっている

key: FERN: Sigh.
en: FERN: Sigh.
ja: ファーン: はぁ

key: Those dumb kids can't do anything right, can they?
en: Those dumb kids can't do anything right, can they?
ja: あのバカどもは　ろくに　何も　できねぇのか

key: Look, \PN, really, don't take it personally,
en: Look, \PN, really, don't take it personally,
ja: なあ　\PN　本気で　悪く思うなよ

key: But I know a loser when I see one.
en: But I know a loser when I see one.
ja: オレ様は　負け犬を　見れば　わかるんだ

key: You can only coast by on luck and pity for so long.
en: You can only coast by on luck and pity for so long.
ja: 運と　同情だけで　やっていけるのは　そう長くねぇぞ

key: So come on, smile!
en: So come on, smile!
ja: ほら　笑えよ!

key: By not letting you embarrass yourself in our Gym, really I'm doing YOU a favor.
en: By not letting you embarrass yourself in our Gym, really I'm doing YOU a favor.
ja: うちのジムで　恥をかかずに　済ませてやる。テメーのためだぜ

key: Naturally, you won't even thank me!
en: Naturally, you won't even thank me!
ja: どうせ　礼のひとつも　言わねぇんだろ!

key: But it's fine.
en: But it's fine.
ja: まあ　いいさ

key: Evidently I gotta be used to thankless work.
en: Evidently I gotta be used to thankless work.
ja: どうやら　報われない仕事には　慣れるしかねぇらしい

key: Now, just turn around, go home, and give up.
en: Now, just turn around, go home, and give up.
ja: さあ　回れ右して　帰って　あきらめな

key: FERN: ...Yeah, I didn't really think you'd be smart enough to listen to me.
en: FERN: ...Yeah, I didn't really think you'd be smart enough to listen to me.
ja: ファーン: ……ああ　テメーが　素直に聞くほど　賢いとは　思ってなかったぜ

key: Fine. Have it your way, man.
en: Fine. Have it your way, man.
ja: いいさ。好きにしろよ

key: This isn't over.
en: This isn't over.
ja: まだ終わっちゃいねぇぞ

key: FERN: ...
en: FERN: ...
ja: ファーン: ……

key: You're infuriating, really.
en: You're infuriating, really.
ja: テメーは　本当に　腹立たしいぜ

key: Outcome or not, the difference between us isn't that great.
en: Outcome or not, the difference between us isn't that great.
ja: 結果はどうあれ　オレ様とテメーの差は　たいして　ねぇんだよ

key: So why is it like this again, huh?
en: So why is it like this again, huh?
ja: なのに　なんで　またこうなる?

key: Is it the badge?
en: Is it the badge?
ja: バッジのせいか?

key: You think you're SO cool, just because you're doing the whole Gym League thing?
en: You think you're SO cool, just because you're doing the whole Gym League thing?
ja: ジムリーグを　まわってるだけで　えらく　かっこいいつもりか?

key: And apparently the Flobot agrees.
en: And apparently the Flobot agrees.
ja: しかも　フロボットまで　そう思ってるらしいな

key: No, you know what?
en: No, you know what?
ja: いや　いいことを　思いついたぜ

key: Two can play at that game, \PN.
en: Two can play at that game, \PN.
ja: その手なら　オレ様も　使えるんだよ　\PN

key: If a second rate Trainer like you can keep up, then I won't have any problem sweeping the Reborn League.
en: If a second rate Trainer like you can keep up, then I won't have any problem sweeping the Reborn League.
ja: テメーみてぇな　二流が　ついていけるなら　オレ様が　リボーンリーグを　総なめにするのは　わけねぇな

key: I should thank you, \PN.
en: I should thank you, \PN.
ja: 礼を言うべきだな　\PN

key: But I'm not going to.
en: But I'm not going to.
ja: だが　言わねぇ

key: You haven't earned that, and I've got better things to do.
en: You haven't earned that, and I've got better things to do.
ja: テメーには　その値打ちがねぇし　オレ様には　もっと大事な用が　ある

key: Later, loser!
en: Later, loser!
ja: じゃあな　負け犬!

key: Sorry, the Gym is closed while Miss Florinia is away.
en: Sorry, the Gym is closed while Miss Florinia is away.
ja: ごめんね　フロリニアさんが　留守の間　ジムは　閉まってるんだ

key: I was specifically asked not to let anyone in until she gets back.
en: I was specifically asked not to let anyone in until she gets back.
ja: もどるまで　誰も　入れるなって　わざわざ　たのまれててね

key: Which frankly, is sort of unfortunate... There was a lot I wanted to do.
en: Which frankly, is sort of unfortunate... There was a lot I wanted to do.
ja: 正直　ちょっと　残念だけど……やりたいことが　たくさん　あったんだ

key: To think I was going to confess before all of this happened...
en: To think I was going to confess before all of this happened...
ja: こんなことになる前に　告白するつもりだったのに……

key: This sucks.
en: This sucks.
ja: 最悪だよ

key: Hey! Would you be willing to do me a favor?
en: Hey! Would you be willing to do me a favor?
ja: ねえ! ひとつ　たのまれてくれない?

key: Here, take this and deliver it with this note for me?
en: Here, take this and deliver it with this note for me?
ja: これを　この手紙といっしょに　届けてほしいんだ

key: I spent all night making it. It'll definitely win them over!
en: I spent all night making it. It'll definitely win them over!
ja: 一晩かけて　作ったんだ。きっと　心に　ひびくはず!

key: My crush usually hangs out around the third floor.
en: My crush usually hangs out around the third floor.
ja: 好きな人は　たいてい　3階あたりに　いるよ

key: Please convey my feelings for me!
en: Please convey my feelings for me!
ja: ぼくの気持ちを　伝えてきて!

key: Have you delivered it yet?!
en: Have you delivered it yet?!
ja: もう　届けてくれた!?

key: Make sure to tell me what to say!
en: Make sure to tell me what to say!
ja: なんて言われたか　必ず　教えてね!

key: What'd she say?!
en: What'd she say?!
ja: 彼女　なんて　言ってた!?

key: Oh.
en: Oh.
ja: そう
……そう

key: Then that night we spent together on Beryl Bridge... Was that really nothing to her?
en: Then that night we spent together on Beryl Bridge...  Was that really nothing to her?
ja: じゃあ　ベリル大橋で　いっしょに過ごした　あの夜は……彼女にとって　何でも　なかったの?

key: I thought for sure--
en: I thought for sure--
ja: てっきり——

key: Oh, but I always do this! I always overthink things!
en: Oh, but I always do this! I always overthink things!
ja: ああ　ぼくは　いつもこうだ! いつも　考えすぎるんだ!

key: Why do I always have to fall in love with my friends just over a few precious moments?!
en: Why do I always have to fall in love with my friends just over a few precious moments?!
ja: どうして　ほんの少しの　大切な時間だけで　友達を　好きになってしまうんだろう!?

key: Forget it... It's over now.
en: Forget it... It's over now.
ja: もういいんだ……終わったことだよ

key: I'm sorry you had to hear all my whining and poor expectations.
en: I'm sorry you had to hear all my whining and poor expectations.
ja: ぐちや　みっともない期待に　つきあわせて　ごめんね

key: Look, I just want to let it go.
en: Look, I just want to let it go.
ja: もう　手放したいんだ

key: I was gonna give her a present later... I went through a lot of trouble getting it.
en: I was gonna give her a present later... I went through a lot of trouble getting it.
ja: あとで　プレゼントを　わたすつもりだった……苦労して　手に入れたんだ

key: But I don't think I can do that now.
en: But I don't think I can do that now.
ja: でも　もう　できそうにない

key: So just take this away from me. It was for her favorite Pokémon, but...
en: So just take this away from me. It was for her favorite Pokémon, but...
ja: だから　これを　持っていって。彼女の　お気に入りのポケモンに　と思ったんだけど……

key: You can just call it my apology.
en: You can just call it my apology.
ja: ぼくからの　おわびだと　思ってよ

key: I have a Gym to guard. That's all I'll ever get probably.
en: I have a Gym to guard. That's all I'll ever get probably.
ja: ぼくには　守るべきジムが　ある。たぶん　それだけなんだ

key: No, really... I'm fine...
en: No, really... I'm fine...
ja: いや　本当に……だいじょうぶだから……
